info.title: coursebook.golf API
info.description: JSON API for the coursebook.golf web, iOS and Android clients. Authenticate with a Clerk session token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every failure returns the ApiError envelope. The contract only grows: fields and error codes are added, never renamed or removed.

ClerkSession.description: A Clerk session token from the web, iOS or Android SDK.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Current values: bad_request, validation_failed, us_state_required, unauthenticated, account_deleted, username_invalid, not_found, course_not_found, not_on_list, round_not_found, member_not_found, friendship_not_found, top_list_not_found, payload_too_large, unsupported_media_type, account_deletion_incomplete, search_unavailable, internal. New codes may appear; treat unknown codes by HTTP status.

message.description: Explanation suitable to show to the member.

Member.description: Another member's public projection; never an email or an id.

played.description: The member's rounds at this course.

lastPlayedOn.description: The member's latest dated round here; null when none is dated.

myRank.description: The viewer's own rank for this course; null when it is not on the viewer's list.

relationship.description: self or friends. New values may appear.

friendsSince.description: When the friendship was accepted; null on the viewer's own profile.

topFour.description: The member's personal ranks 1-4 (fewer for a shorter list).

roundsThisYear.description: Rounds dated in the current calendar year (UTC).

inCommon.description: Courses both members have ranked; null on the viewer's own profile.

agreement.description: Share of shared-course pairs both members order the same way; null below three shared courses or on the viewer's own profile.

biggestSplits.description: Courses whose positions differ most, largest first; at most one today, empty when there is nothing to compare.

RankComparison.description: How a member's ranking compares with the viewer's. Always present, so clients never decode a null object.

RankSplit.description: The shared course whose positions differ most, relative to each list's length.

rounds.description: Newest played first; undated rounds last.

get.description: Public and cacheable: responses carry an ETag; send it as If-None-Match to receive 304 when nothing changed. Send no Authorization header so shared caches can store it.
